scope: Existing shared staged-art fixture; not a production game crash

findings.evidence: Both contact and detail pages navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4174 before setContent. The plain repository-root server returns the actual index.html, whose Vite main.jsx script has application/octet-stream MIME type. A real module-load console error is recorded for otherwise decoded images.
findings.observedEffect: All four recovered Lighting files returned 200, decoded at 600x600 with opaqueFraction 1 and were screenshot-captured, but the preexisting module error made the strict per-image gate fail.
findings.narrowRepair: Use an inert same-origin fixture document rather than root app index.html. Keep image/page/request error assertions enabled; do not suppress this error by string matching. Rerun the actual shared fixture after an owner-approved change.
findings.interactiveAction: No shared renderer/runtime changes. Added bounded image-only verification for exactly the four recovered hashes, leaving the original shared failure recorded separately.

findings.evidence: Existing staged desk WebP files decoded at 512x512 but all 48x48 alpha probe samples were transparent, opaqueFraction 0. These are unrelated to Lighting recovery and were not modified by CHAT.
findings.narrowRepair: Check the actual latest bytes and full-resolution sources. Recover or replace these defective derivatives only if the same invalid versions remain current. Never treat valid file signatures/dimensions as visible final artwork. Preserve failed hashes and do not lower the alpha/nonblank assertion.

safety: No reference images, game runtime, canonical mapping, curriculum, prices, unlocks, player saves or tests were altered to hide a defect. Replit, Floot and main were not touched.
